class TestGcdHappyPath:
    """Tests for typical, expected usage with positive integers."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "a, b, expected",
        [
            (1, 1, 1),
            (2, 3, 1),          # coprime
            (4, 6, 2),
            (17, 19, 1),        # primes
            (54, 24, 6),
            (48, 180, 12),
            (100, 10, 10),      # multiple
            (7, 7, 7),
            (1, 0, 1),
            (0, 1, 1),
        ],
    )
    def test_gcd_positive(self, a, b, expected):
        assert gcd(a, b) == expected
        # Order should not matter
        assert gcd(b, a) == expected

            (0, -5, 5),
